messages:
maya-support: Hey team — customer reports free-trial credits never showed up after signup. They verified email, applied promo code NEW2026 at onboarding, then added Apple Pay and switched to a company card right after. Billing page shows 0 credits. Can someone check?
eli-cs: Can you paste the account_id and approx signup time? Also whether promo_redeem returned success or error on the client side.
maya-support: account_id: acct_01G7Z9, signup_ts: 1930012301, promo_code: NEW2026, client saw promo accepted message. Payment history: apple_pay (tokenized) then replaced by card ending 4242 ~ 1930012306. Customer attached screenshot of billing UI showing "No trial credits".
sam-backend: I can look in the backend. Likely race between promo_redeem and payment-method change. I'll check the `trial-grant` queue and the promo webhook logs.
maya-support: Customer says they waited ~10 mins and then tried a call to /v1/credits which returned 0. No errors surfaced to them.
sam-backend: Found promo_redeem event at 1930012303 with redeem_id r-89ab. It enqueued grant job g-89ab. Grant job failed at 1930012308 with error `payment_method_mismatch` from billing-service: primary payment method expected tokenized apple_pay but account primary was updated to card 4242 before grant completed.
eli-cs: Policy: we only auto-grant when the payment method on the redeem event matches the account primary and passes basic anti-fraud checks. Switching PM mid-flow can trigger a manual review.
maya-support: Is there a safe manual path so we can get credits to this user while they provide verification? Customer is blocked.
sam-backend: I can re-run the grant against redeem_id r-89ab with a `force_grant=true` flag, but that requires an audit entry and approval. If fraud checks are clean we can do it. Also we should replay the success path so the UI shows credits.
billing-bot: Reminder: manual grants require a Jira ticket INF-TRIAL with justification and approver. Also include last4, auth timestamp, and promo code.
eli-cs: Ask customer for either the 3DS/authorization screenshot or the auth tx id for card 4242. If they provide it and matching IP/geo is OK, give support +1 for manual grant.
maya-support: Pinged customer for 3DS screenshot and auth tx id. Filed INF-TRIAL-5234 with account_id + redeem_id + logs. Waiting on their reply. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
sam-backend: After we have approval I'll re-run grant and follow up with a trace link. Leaving a note: we should make the grant job tolerant to PM swaps within a short window to avoid this class of race. Filing follow-up infra task.
maya-support: Thanks — will update once customer responds.
